items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: Howard came in and went to work with us

ctx.x: Oh, boy, you know what I mean. Because after I put it all together, you know, and because he wanted to pay my way, you know. He said, 'Oh, I'll pay your way. You don't have to touch your money.' I said, 'Well, man, we got a job here to go on. You going to stand on the job?' 'No, no.' But we went to work for the county commissioner. He had a club down there and also Howard McGee was there.
